install_steps: sc mattpocock-skills self setup  — runs `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills` (interactive installer, select your agent and the /setup-matt-pocock-skills skill)
sc mattpocock-skills self list   — verify which skills are installed
sc mattpocock-skills self status — check installation status per agent target
Inside Claude Code / Cursor, run /setup-matt-pocock-skills to complete configuration (issue tracker, labels, docs location)
note: Requires Node.js 18+ and npm. The skills provide slash-commands (/grill-me, /tdd, /to-prd, /diagnose, etc.) within AI coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor. The plugin wraps the npx installer and provides management commands, but actual skill usage happens inside the agent via slash-commands. ~55k stars on GitHub, one of the most popular AI coding agent skill sets.
